## Quick Reference

| Element | Value |
|---------|-------|
| Mark | ɳSelf |
| Primary color | `#6366F1` (Indigo) |
| Background | `#0F0F1A` |
| Font | System default (no custom font required) |
| Icon format | PNG (source SVG where available) |
| Master size | 512×512 px |

## Assets Location

Brand binary assets (PNG, ICO) are stored in `.github/wiki/brand/` in the main repository. These are excluded from the GitHub Wiki sync (binary files don't belong in the wiki git repo).

To use brand assets in your project, reference them from the main repo or download from the latest release.
